atoms.text: Hanukkah is a Jewish festival that lasts eight days every year.
Celebrated in the month of December, it is referred to as the 'Festival of Lights' and has been going on for thousands of years.
Often, children play with a spinning top decorated with Hebrew letters. This is called a 'dreidel' and is a typical Jewish toy that is played with at Hanukkah.
The aim is to guess correctly which letter the dreidel will land on.

atoms.text: The leopard, often found in parts of sub-Saharan Africa and Asia, is arguably one of the most beautiful big cats in the family. With a lifespan of around 12-17 years, they rule the areas they live in.

The lion is also a resident of parts of sub-Saharan Africa. Although regarded the 'King' of the animal kingdom, there are still many conservation efforts happening in order to protect this majestic species from extinction.
An example of a charity that helps to protect lions is the WWF. In an interview with the WWF, Seb Heap told us about how he wanted to save the animals.
“Hi Seb, what are your plans for the lions?”
“In order to save this beautiful species, we want to stop people hunting as much as possible and save them from extinction,” said Seb.
